record.what_it_does: Reducto is an API platform that parses, classifies, extracts structured data from, splits, and edits documents (PDFs, scans, spreadsheets, DOCX, etc.) for AI/LLM pipelines.
record.auth_notes: API calls use `Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY` with a key generated in Reducto Studio (studio.reducto.ai/api-keys). The MCP CLI additionally offers a browser-based OAuth device-code login (`uvx mcp-server-reducto --login`) that ultimately just saves an API key to `~/.reducto/config.yaml` — it is a convenience login flow, not a third-party delegated-auth OAuth2 grant.
record.access_notes: Sign up free at studio.reducto.ai and immediately create an API key; the Standard plan includes 15K free credits pay-as-you-go with no page limits, then $0.015/credit.
